cast.name: Brian Tracy
cast.role: the author and experienced executive coach delivering principles of disciplined execution
cast.look: Brian Tracy, a distinguished man in his early 70s, short neatly combed silver hair, warm yet authoritative expression, wearing a tailored charcoal grey business suit, white dress shirt, and a burgundy silk tie.

cast.name: Overwhelmed Professional
cast.role: an ambitious manager buried under trivial tasks, urgent emails, and chronic procrastination
cast.look: A professional in his late 30s, slim athletic build, short dark messy hair, wearing a slightly wrinkled slate blue dress shirt with rolled-up sleeves, loosened tie, dark circles under focused but exhausted eyes.

cast.name: Focused Colleague
cast.role: a colleague or peer demonstrating the clarity, boundary-setting, and calm of single-handling high-value work
cast.look: A sharp woman in her early 40s, composed demeanor, straight shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a crisp cream blazer over a dark top, posture relaxed and attentive.
